Description: Unofficial PowerShell module for the Linear (linear.app) GraphQL API. Pipeline-friendly cmdlets for issues with comments, attachments and relations; projects, milestones and status updates; initiatives; documents; teams, labels, cycles and users. Includes sign-in through the browser (OAuth with PKCE), git branch integration, automatic paging, rate-limit handling and an escape hatch for raw GraphQL.

Drops elevated privileges (Administrators group made deny-only, Medium
integrity) and runs a command, or an interactive shell when no command is

SSH, where an administrator account always gets an elevated session.

A PowerShell 7 module for managing work and personal tasks or to-do items. This module uses a SQLite database to store task and category information. The module is not a full-featured project management solution, but should be fine for personal needs. The module requires a 64-bit Windows or Linux platform.
